question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word in the given sentence.

I __agreed__ with your assessment.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Supported.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Agreed"** means to have the same opinion or to accept a suggestion or statement. (सहमत होना)

 
 
• **English Meaning:** To consent or concur with something.
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** सहमत होना
 
• **Example:** I agreed with her proposal to change the meeting schedule.
 
 
 
• The word **"Supported"** means to back up or endorse a statement, idea, or person. (समर्थन करना)
 
 
• **English Meaning:** To give approval or encouragement to something.
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** समर्थन करना
 
• **Example:** The teacher supported the student in his decision to pursue his passion.
 
 
 
• Since to "agree" with someone often implies supporting their viewpoint or assessment, we can infer that the most appropriate meaning of "agreed" in this context is **"supported"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 - Supported**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Rejected **(अस्वीकार करना): To refuse to accept or agree with something.

 
 
• **Example:** The team rejected his idea as it was not feasible.
 
 
 
• **Doubted **(संदेह करना): To feel uncertain or question the truth of something.
 
 
• **Example:** She doubted his ability to complete the task on time.
 
 
 
• **Disagreed** (असहमत होना): To have a different opinion or not agree with someone.
 
 
• **Example:** They disagreed on how to handle the situation.
